Use the preview as a taste check

Open the closest complete page and borrow its hierarchy, pacing, and proof standard. Do not copy its claims or treat its section order as a fill-in template. Compose real content from the component source after the reader job is clear.

Route out when the page is not the product

Mutable editors and product UI belong to design; filter-driven analysis and simulations belong to an interactive visualization workflow; durable repository documentation belongs to docs-writer.

Illustrative references only. Outcome pages calibrate judgment; reusable component source remains the implementation truth.
